reason: My notes live in Goodnotes on my iPad and I like writing by hand, and whatever else I track is already in Notion for free. I might poke at the free tier once out of curiosity, but I'm not paying another $6 a month to move my stuff somewhere new.
objection: Notion already does folders, journals and trackers and it's free. I don't see why I'd pay to have an assistant build what I can set up myself in twenty minutes, and I don't trust it to read my handwriting right.
would_change_my_mind: If I could snap a page of my handwritten Goodnotes notes and it reliably turned them into something searchable and sorted, and that kept working for a month on the free tier.
